purpose: Teach: 照らし/記さ/屈し/残留/広範囲/生じる/通念/護衛

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、月明かりが照らした風景を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was about moonlit landscapes, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, observant opening. Warm recognition of the student's work. Steady, patient pace. Not quite a question — more of a kindly confirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古文書に記された伝承を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on folklore recorded in ancient documents.
lines.style: Quiet, precise delivery. Slight nervousness in the breath — careful to get the facts right. Eyes briefly down, then back up. Respectful but not strained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 権力に屈した思想家を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper explored thinkers who compromised under pressure, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured, almost gentle probing. Inviting him to expand. The tone of someone genuinely curious about how he thinks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、海洋に残留する化学物質を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined chemical residue accumulating in the ocean.
lines.style: Steady correction without defensiveness. Calm, factual delivery. A slight edge of focus — he's clarifying what he actually wrote about.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 広範囲に影響を及ぼす地震を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And your paper dealt with wide-ranging seismic impact, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, slightly more direct. The rhythm picks up faintly. Warmth in the voice — she's genuinely interested in following the thread of his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ストレスから生じる病を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote on illness that arises from chronic stress.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. The words settle naturally. No rush. A quiet steadiness that suggests he's been thinking about this carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古い社会通念を覆した運動を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper was about movements that challenged old social conventions, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, inviting. Slight lift in tone — drawing out the bigger picture. Patient and present, like she's watching how he connects the ideas.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、要人の護衛体制を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined security protocols for protecting high-ranking officials.
lines.style: Final correction, firm but not tense. Clear, direct delivery. A slight closing energy — acknowledging the pattern, stating it precisely, moving toward completion.
